The '''Leisure Zone''' was an area on the [[planet]] [[Morlana One]] that included [[brothel]]s. It was under the jurisdiction of the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]]. In [[5 BBY]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] visited a [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] in the Leisure Zone in search of [[Kerri|his sister]], whom he had been separated from at a young age. He later [[Death|killed]] two [[Tac-Corpo|Corpos]] in the area and when they were discovered, [[Chief Inspector]] [[Hyne]] ordered [[Syril Karn]] to create an alibi for the situation, instructing him to come up with a story that saw the two men die innocuously and outside of the area.<ref name="Kassa" />

{{Loc-stub}}
